# identity.Device

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A device principal of an organization, activated with a one-time code (SP1 spec §6.4).

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `identity.Device` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.device.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the device was activated (UTC). |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | Device id; also the Firebase Auth uid of the device. |  |
| `label` | yes | `none` | Name given at activation, e.g. `Front desk tablet`. |  |
| `lastSeenAt` | yes | `none` | Last authenticated request (UTC); null before the first one. |  |
| `node` | yes | `none` | Node the device was activated at; its grant lives there. |  |
| `status` | yes | `none` | `revoked` devices cannot sign in. |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Organization the device belongs to. |  |
| `updatedAt` | yes | `none` | When the device last changed (UTC). |  |

## Relations

- `belongs-to` `tenancy.Organization` via `tenantId`
